scoring_justification: Cannot fully recompute from raw artifacts without running GULP; checker verifies total lattice energy from ionic+OSPE, lattice parameters and dielectric constants against gold references, and stability ordering.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for computed_properties.csv (lattice parameters, dielectric constants, energies, OSPE)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table I and experimental references in the text (lattice parameter rock salt 0.4267 nm, dielectric eps0=12.9 epsinf=5.3; zinc blende a=0.455 nm, dielectric calculated; wurtzite a=0.321 nm c=0.524 nm, dielectric calculated)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Manually extracted from the paper's Table I and the experimental footnote; embedded inline into grading_spec_json.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact values reported in the paper for the same quantities under the same conditions, ensuring the checker validates against the paper's own conclusions.

outputs.description: The checker compares lattice parameters to experimental references (within 1%), ionic and total lattice energies to paper-calculated references (within 0.1 eV), dielectric constants to experimental/paper-calculated references (within 10%), and verifies the stability ordering of total lattice energies.

output_contract.notes: The solver must extract potential parameters from the Catlow et al. (1977) paper and apply the OSPE addition correctly. The checker uses hidden gold values derived from Table I and experimental references; no network fetch is required.
